maddeler.e:
استرحمن (form X)
# اِسْتَرْحَمْنَ (istarḥamna) /is.tar.ħam.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِسْتَرْحَمَ (istarḥama)
# اُسْتُرْحِمْنَ (usturḥimna) /us.tur.ħim.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِسْتَرْحَمَ (istarḥama)
# اِسْتَرْحِمْنَ (istarḥimna) /is.tar.ħim.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْتَرْحَمَ (istarḥama)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
